range_reason: one trunk, four scenic waistbands: each Modal Stretch Trunk hides a different little landscape nobody but you sees
audience: A 26-year-old in a Bengaluru open-plan office whose desk faces a wall, who orders fun basics online and lives in soft trunks on weekends.
insight: The one good view in a grey cubicle day is the one nobody can see — the scenic waistband hiding under your jeans.
smp: Bummer Modal Stretch Trunks hide a view only you get.
device: a window: a trunk's scenic waistband reads as a framed landscape with a place-name; four views snap in on the four-on-the-floor kick and gather into a wall of them
device_why: Bummer's signature is the photographic scenic waistband, so the product detail literally becomes the 'view' the line is about — the hidden luxury under your clothes

recall.does: soft modal trunks with a scenic-waistband view
recall.why: a different little view hiding under your jeans every day, soft enough to forget you're wearing

claims.text: Modal Stretch Trunks, ₹599, in scenic-waistband prints Aurora / Cold Rush / Foliage / Sunspill

music.title: Aap Jaisa Koi
music.why: the 1980 Qurbani Indo-disco classic (retro, flirty — 'someone like you') for a cheeky little luxury; its four-on-the-floor lets each view land on a kick and the wall of views on the song's biggest kick

look.why: a deep night-sky navy so the scenic waistband 'views' glow like lit windows against it; one sky-cyan accent; the trunks arrive as bright white-bordered postcards

beats.shows: a dull grey office 'window' — a flat rectangle of nothing — on the navy; the cursor-blink feeling of a cubicle

beats.serves: proves it's a collection of real printed views, not one gimmick
